verdicts.reason: The two candidates are nearly identical, and both are broken in the same ways. The city photo collage, the original's key imagery, has shrunk to a tiny thumbnail beside the body copy and is replaced by an empty white diamond outline. The two brown diamonds are cropped at the top edge and crowd the headline. The body text is far too small to read at this size. B's headline and body are very slightly larger, but not enough to make one clearly better.
